name: campaign-ops-mcp
description: Autopilot for Google Ads with a human in the loop: it watches every hour, writes the fix as a proposal, rings your phone, and applies only what you sign with your passkey. An MCP server with Fair Housing guardrails, dry runs, verification, rollback, a tamper-evident audit log checked against Google's own change history, and Pulse alarms. Runs on your computer or on Cloudflare's free plan.
author: Debashish Kumar Bora

scripts.cloud:setup: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js setup
scripts.cloud:deploy: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js deploy
scripts.cloud:code: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js code
scripts.cloud:unlink-desktop: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js unlink-desktop
